{{Otheruses|Security Chief}}
The '''Defensus Security Chief''' was the leader of [[Defensus Solar]] aboard [[Zirtran's Anchor/Legends|''Zirtran's Anchor'']]. The Security Chief had a lot of control over operations on the station, but still had to defer to the [[Geelan]] owners of the station.<ref name="Zirtran's Anchor (article)">{{JournalCite|5|Zirtran's Anchor (article)}}</ref>
